'''Pressurized surface containers''' were a means of travel used on the [[Polis Massa]]. The containers allowed for rapid transit between the [[Wiyentaah/Legends|Local Dig]] and the [[Polis Massa Research Base]] without an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
